$comment: Labeled retrieval-quality dataset for benchmark/quality.mjs. `memories` are inserted into a throwaway brain (plus synthetic distractors); each query lists the ground-truth relevant memory keys. Categories: keyword (shares vocabulary with the claim), paraphrase (different wording — where semantic search should shine), scoped (path-filtered recall).

memories.claim: All database access goes through the MemoryStore wrapper in src/db/store.ts; never import better-sqlite3 directly
JWT access tokens expire after 15 minutes; refresh tokens after 30 days
The HTTP client retries idempotent requests 3 times with exponential backoff and jitter
All timestamps are stored as UTC ISO-8601 strings; never use local time
Payment webhook handlers must be idempotent; deduplicate on the Stripe event id
Schema migrations must run before SCHEMA_SQL because indexes reference migrated columns
Session data is cached in Redis with a 24-hour TTL; SQLite remains the source of truth
Prisma ORM was abandoned due to cold-start overhead; raw prepared statements are used instead
API rate limiting uses a token-bucket algorithm at 100 requests per minute per API key
All external input is validated with zod schemas at the API boundary
Failed queue messages go to a dead-letter queue after 5 delivery attempts
Never commit secrets; all credentials come from environment variables loaded in src/config
Feature flags are evaluated server-side only; client bundles never contain flag logic
User records are soft-deleted with a deleted_at column; hard deletes happen only via the GDPR erasure job
CSV exports must escape formula-injection characters (=, +, -, @) in user-supplied cells
WebSocket connections send heartbeat pings every 30 seconds; clients reconnect after 2 missed pongs
UI strings use i18n message keys; no hard-coded English text in components
Transactional emails are sent asynchronously via the queue, never inline in request handlers
List endpoints use cursor-based pagination; offset pagination was rejected for deep-page performance
Never log PII; user identifiers are hashed before being written to structured logs

queries.query: how long before a login session needs refreshing
what happens when an outgoing request fails temporarily
where do broken background jobs end up
can I remove a user row permanently
why did we stop using an object-relational mapper
avoiding duplicate charges when Stripe calls us twice
sending a welcome message inside the signup route
